headings.text: We bring your digital vision to life

At Nami Corporation, we excel at providing innovative and advanced web and mobile solutions. We specialize in Design and development of websites and mobile applications tailored to meet the needs of our customers unique. Explore how we can help you achieve your digital goals with the best quality and highest standards.

paragraphs: Al-Nahdi Family Office is an introductory site for a trusted family office that collaborates with our partners to apply best practices in our areas of operation. We are committed to achieving the family's ambitions, fostering institutional growth, and ensuring long-term sustainability.

Easily Manage Your Sheep Herd with the "Maqani" App Enhance the management of your sheep herd effortlessly with the "Maqani" app. We provide you with a unique experience to record and track your herd’s data in a simple and convenient way, allowing you to focus on the care and development of your sheep. We are here to make managing your herd easy and enjoyable, with features like health data recording, care schedules, and more, all in one app.

Tasami is a comprehensive digital platform designed to help users transform their ambitions and goals into realistic, actionable plans. The platform combines AI-powered tools, personal assistants, supportive communities, and goal-tracking features to support users throughout their journey toward achieving their goals. It includes a web platform and mobile application for an integrated user experience.

Bena'at is a specialized educational platform designed to support families throughout their journey of building a healthy family and raising conscious, well-rounded children. The app provides comprehensive educational content and courses delivered by specialists in family and parenting fields.

The Abu Batal Slaughterhouse app allows you to purchase the finest livestock meat with ease and convenience. We offer fresh slaughterhouses of various types (sheep, goats, wild goats, and other animals), with multiple options for cutting and preparing according to your preference.

A dedicated application for providing instant maintenance services for homes and businesses, with the option to purchase maintenance supplies through the same platform. It aims to simplify access to trusted technicians and ensure the purchase of necessary tools with guaranteed quality and fast execution.

find you dream job Easily get job offers Introducing "Jobs In Saudi" - the game-changing app for job seekers in Saudi Arabia. Find your dream job with ease, stay updated with the latest listings, and kickstart your career journey like never before. Join us today and unlock endless possibilities.

Sale Gates is an online marketplace application that brings together individuals, businesses, and gallery owners on a single platform for buying, selling, and showcasing services. The application provides a user-friendly and organized experience, with no commissions or fees, and features AI support to facilitate searching and browsing, giving every user a fair space to display their products and services.

A specialized medical recruitment platform that connects healthcare institutions with medical professionals across various specialties and countries. The platform enables employers to post job opportunities, search for suitable candidates, and manage the hiring process efficiently, while allowing job seekers to explore relevant opportunities, showcase their profiles, and apply for positions that match their expertise. The platform aims to streamline medical recruitment and bridge the gap between healthcare talent and opportunities on both local and international levels.

Loryfy is a digital platform that connects existing business owners and entrepreneurs with potential investors and business partners. It enables investors to discover available opportunities and communicate directly with business owners through private in-app messaging.

Prainsa specializes in the design and production of ready-mix concrete, providing comprehensive solutions to meet the needs of construction projects. We focus on delivering high-quality concrete products, designed according to the latest standards and requirements, to ensure optimal results for your construction endeavors.

15s meals is the largest account for creating and sharing food recipes in the Arab world. We offer a wide range of innovative and delicious recipes that cater to all tastes, focusing on presenting new and unique ideas for cooking that blend traditional and modern flavors.
A website for Al-Majed Recruitment Company in Jeddah, one of the most established recruitment offices in the Kingdom.
A website for Dar Daleel Real Estate, a leading real estate company specializing in property marketing and management, powered by a team of young Saudi professionals.

Saudi Treasures is a tourism website that offers an easy experience for choosing and booking tourism packages inside and outside the Kingdom, with flight and hotel booking services and organizing trips to various destinations, from Saudi islands and beaches to European cities.

A corporate website developed for CORE Portfolio to showcase its services and projects in the design and construction industry, highlighting its diverse expertise across commercial, residential, hospitality, retail, healthcare, and industrial sectors. The website enhances the company's digital presence and presents its services and strengths in a professional manner that reflects the quality of its work and excellence in project delivery.

A professional corporate website for INNOVA Tech Global Solutions, designed to introduce the company, showcase its technology services and solutions, and present its expertise and areas of work through a modern and well-structured digital presence.

Alammah is an informative website offering services and products specifically tailored to meet the needs of major institutions and private and government sectors. We are committed to providing comprehensive and efficient solutions that support operational processes and help our clients achieve their goals with high quality and reliability, making us a trusted partner in fulfilling various organizational requirements.
A website for Steel Beams Construction Co. Ltd.

A website for 7aser Real Estate, a closed joint-stock Saudi company, and one of the largest residential real estate development companies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, adhering to the highest quality standards.

Reef Al-Jawf is a digital platform dedicated to serving the Al-Jawf region in Saudi Arabia, offering users an easy way to explore daily chalet rentals, view property details, and connect for booking. The platform also brings together recreational activities and local food and beverage services for a more comprehensive experience.
An online platform that allows users to list their own properties for rent, whether administrative, commercial, or residential, making it easier for others to view them and connect with the owners.
A smart application for buying, selling, and renting real estate, with the ability to manage your properties professionally.

The application functions as a comprehensive platform for property and real estate management, allowing property owners to add and manage their properties, tenants to request rentals or maintenance, and real estate agents to manage leasing processes and mediation between parties.

Tatawer is a site that features a large team of highly skilled contractors to meet all your construction service needs. Our experienced team is dedicated to bringing your project vision to life and delivering exceptional results.

3M is a website that offers a wide range of top car care brands under one roof, including products for car care such as window films, paint protection films, paint and polishing products, and window building solutions.
Shohnatk is a transportation and shipping application designed to make moving goods and personal belongings easier and safer, including livestock and personal items.
Mori is an all-in-one delivery and transportation app that allows users to easily order food, groceries, and send shipments, while enabling drivers to accept orders and earn flexible income.
An application consisting of two separate apps, one dedicated to drivers and the other to customers, providing an integrated and seamless experience in transportation and delivery services.
An application that provides delivery services, making travel easier and more comfortable.
Nami provides integrated software solutions for web and mobile applications, helping companies scale with reliable digital products.
